info.title: Acmebot CLI
info.description: Command-line client for Acmebot HTTP API automation.

options.name: --endpoint
options.description: Acmebot application URL. Overrides saved config and ACMEBOT_ENDPOINT.

options.name: --audience
options.description: Microsoft Entra application ID URI. Overrides saved config and ACMEBOT_AUDIENCE.

options.name: --config
options.description: CLI configuration file path. Env: ACMEBOT_CONFIG

options.name: --name
options.description: Key Vault certificate name. Defaults to the first DNS name.

options.name: --reuse-key
options.description: Reuse the Key Vault certificate key.

options.name: --no-wait
options.description: Return after the operation is accepted.
